title: Prod deploy runner notes
content:
Personal runner notes for prod deploy (day-of). Quick scratchpad for myself — copy to shared runbook after launch if useful.

OVERVIEW / GOAL:
- Deploy service v2.7.0 to prod pool A/B with zero-downtime routing.
- Primary target: reduce tail latency by 18% for 512-token requests.
- Keep SLOs met: p99 < 450ms, error rate < 0.2%.

TIMELINE (approx):
- T-90m: final smoke on staging, tag build (CI artifact: build-2026-03-09-1718).
- T-60m: merge hotfix backports (rel-eng/backport-rl-3421).
- T-30m: pre-cutover comms to #releng-rollouts + stakeholders.
- T: start canary (10% traffic -> new model-handler binary).
- T+10m: check metrics, if green -> ramp to 50%.
- T+30m: full ramp to 100% (or abort).
- T+90m: post-cutover verification & closeout notes.

CHECKLIST (day-of quick items):
- [ ] Confirm build SHA and artifact uploaded: sha: ab12c9f (CI link above).
- [ ] Ensure Dedicated pool capacity reserved for burst (ops-approved).
- [ ] Notify SRE on-call (pager: @sre-oncall).
- [ ] Open monitoring windows: grafana zoomed to PREVIEW window, latency & errors pinned.
- [ ] Pre-warm KV cache (script: ./tools/prewarm-prefixes.sh --prefixes common-prompts).
- [ ] Snapshot current routing config (api: GET /routing/v1/config -> save JSON).
- [ ] Create rollback tag (git tag rollback/pre-deploy-ab12c9f).

CANARY RUNBOOK (manual steps):
1) Start canary via orchestration: ./deploy.sh --env prod --pool A --tag ab12c9f --pct 10
2) Wait 5m, run smoke tests: ./test/smoke.sh --env prod --pool A --endpoints generate,embed
3) Check metrics:
   - latency p50/p95/p99 in grafana panel "prod-latency"
   - errors in "ingress-errors" (should be < 0.2%)
   - throughput stable (qps per-node)
4) If any metric breaches: abort canary -> rollback: ./deploy.sh --rollback --tag rollback/pre-deploy-ab12c9f and notify #releng-rollouts.

BACKPORTS / HOTFIXES (local notes):
- REL-3421: fix for kv cache evict race — landed in release branch, needs manual cherry-pick for 2.6.x for older clusters.
- REL-3430: improved kernel selector telemetry (non-blocking).
- Backport plan: cherry-pick REL-3421 -> run unit tests -> publish artifact. Commands: 
  git checkout release/2.6.x && git cherry-pick -x <commit> && ./ci/run-tests.sh --unit

COMMUNICATIONS (templates / copy to paste):
- Pre-cutover (T-30): "Heads-up: starting canary deploy for service v2.7.0 at T (UTC). Expect short routing blips; SRE standing by. Links: <CI>, <grafana>."
- Canary stable (T+12): "Canary at 10% stable. No errors observed. Proceeding to 50% in 10m unless issues."
- Full rollout (T+40): "Full rollout complete. Watch for increased telemetry for 30m; filing post-deploy notes."
- Rollback notice: "Rollback executed to tag rollback/pre-deploy-ab12c9f due to metric regression: p99 latency spike / error rate increase. Investigating."

QUICK TROUBLESHOOT COMMANDS (for oncall & myself):
- tail logs for canary pods: kubectl -n prod logs -l app=model-handler -c handler --since=10m
- restart pod: kubectl rollout restart deployment/model-handler --namespace prod
- dump KV stats: curl -s http://<kv-host>/stats | jq .cache_hit_rate
- evict cache prefixes (if cache poisoning suspected): curl -X POST http://<admin>/cache/evict -d '{"prefix":"user:kv:"}'

KNOWN RISKS & MITIGATIONS:
- Risk: increased p99 due to new kernel path on older GPUs. Mitigation: canary in pool with mixed hardware; fallback policy set to previous model variant.
- Risk: backport cherry-pick flake. Mitigation: run unit + integration quick suite and gate manual approval.

POST-DEPLOY (immediate):
- [ ] Collect logs for release window (T -5m : T +90m) and attach to release ticket REL-3421.
- [ ] Short postmortem notes: list regressions and root cause guesses.
- [ ] Update runbook and move any transient steps to infra-as-code if repeated.
- [ ] Remind product stakeholders about feature flag state and any customer-facing changes.

NOTES TO SELF (scrappy):
- Keep messages terse; ops channel gets noisy. Prefix important messages with [DEPLOY].
- If I step away during ramp, assign explicit owner in thread ("@Lina taking next 20m").
- Remember to run the billing check -> ensure burst didn't cause unexpected charges.

OPEN QUESTIONS / TODOS (follow up after deploy):
- Should we default canary to 5% for lower-risk infra? Pros/cons list.
- Add a synthetic test for big-payload generation to catch p99 regressions earlier.
- Automate cache pre-warm into deploy pipeline.

END OF SCRATCHPAD

(Will clean up and copy to shared runbook: shared_drives/company/misc/runbooks/prod-deploys after verified)
